sources: Flare 2.0 练后 专项补强 + Flare2 2026-11-21（Google 表 1aCseEk4vslsG-QKb-zsZwg30amvoYh5tMxzy6p9n8vA，练后专项补强：俯卧 T-W（无 Y））

purpose.zh: 趴着把手臂摆成 T 和 W 抬离垫子，练肩胛和肩后侧，让撑地和倒立时肩膀更稳
purpose.en: Lying face down, lift your arms in a T and then a W. Strengthens the shoulder blades and the backs of the shoulders for support and handstand work.

text.zh: 肩胛往中间夹，手臂整条抬离垫子
text.en: Squeeze shoulder blades, lift the whole arm

text.zh: T：双臂伸直向两侧平举，拇指朝上。
text.en: T: arms straight out to the sides, thumbs pointing up.

text.zh: W：手肘收在身体两侧，弯成直角，前臂向上转，让手比手肘高。
text.en: W: elbows in by your sides at a right angle, forearms turned up so the hands sit higher than the elbows.

text.zh: 额头朝下、脖子放长，每个位置在最高处停 2 秒。
text.en: Face down, neck long; pause 2 seconds at the top of each shape.

commonErrors.en: Lifting the head and craning the neck.

commonErrors.zh: W 时手肘张开、手比手肘低
commonErrors.en: Elbows flaring and hands dropping below the elbows in the W.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧刺疼就降低抬起高度
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder hurts sharply, lift lower.

training.source: flare2 r3 animation tempo (10 s per rep = T then W: 1.0 s up, 2.0 s top, 0.9 s down, re-set; same for W); 表：顶端停 2 秒，草稿 10 次（T+W 为 1 次）

flare2.item: 练后专项补强：俯卧 T-W（无 Y）
flare2.camera: 头前方斜上（看得到 T、W 手臂形状和离垫高度）
flare2.doseBrief: 表：只做 T、W，顶端停 2 秒；草稿 10 次 1 组（次数待定）
flare2.note: Animation r3: 10 s loop = T (arms out at ~86 deg, thumbs up, lifted ~13 cm, 2 s top) then W (upper arms ~45 deg, elbows 90 deg, forearms turned up ~10 deg above the elbows, 2 s top); shoulder blades retract ~14 mm at the tops; arms re-set on the mat between the shapes.

reminders.zh: 肩胛往中间夹，肩膀离耳朵远一点
reminders.en: Shoulder blades together, shoulders away from your ears

reminders.zh: W 的手肘贴着身体，手比手肘高
reminders.en: In the W, elbows by your sides, hands above the elbows
